limitations: The fixture covers the tested acyclic Packet, Holder and Choice forms through copied Array, List, Option, Product and Except positions, not arbitrary dependent records.
The accepted local runs use Linux x64 with glibc 2.36 and a package floor of 2.36.
External Lean, JDK, Kotlin and Maven toolchain binaries are identified by the retained records but are not copied into this archive.
The closed Maven JAR and native libraries are omitted; their original identities and every retained non-native package member remain archived.
Launch receipts predate an embedded runner digest; this index pins both retained runner sources and maps each cell to the source that produced it.
The initial runner completed the ordinary cells; a continuation runner checked those receipts before producing the reviewed cells.
Constructor entry counters and peak memory are unmeasured.
Hosted Linux x64/glibc 2.38 acceptance remains assigned to the recurring workflow.
